Plowing:  
- Flat acres: \(55 - 15 = 40\)  
- Time: \(\frac{40}{10} + \frac{15}{7} = 4 + \frac{15}{7} = \frac{43}{7}\) days

Mowing:  
- Rainy rate: \(7.2\) acres/day  
- 5 rainy days can mow \(5 \times 7.2 = 36\) acres, which exceeds 30 acres, so mowing finishes during rainy days.  
- Time: \(\frac{30}{7.2} = \frac{25}{6}\) days

Total time:
\[
\frac{43}{7} + \frac{25}{6} = \frac{258 + 175}{42} = \frac{433}{42}
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{433}{42}\text{ days}}
\]
